body:
Maya R: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: we need single owners + concrete ETAs for three customer outputs: (1) one-line statuspage update, (2) plain-language incident summary, (3) policy & gating for full RCAs.
Owen L: I can take (1) and (2). Will keep the statusline to 1-2 sentences and the summary ~350 words. ETA: tomorrow 11:00 UTC.
Priya S: Support will export affected accounts and flag SLA customers. I'll have the CSV with tiers + AM contacts by EOD today.
Maya R: Good. On outreach cadence: SLA customers get proactive email within 24h of summary sign-off; all affected get the sanitized summary on statuspage + ticket within 48h.
Legal Team: Public sanitized summaries are OK. Anything containing customer identifiers, raw logs, trace snippets, or internal credentials needs a DSA or legal review. We'll provide a redaction checklist and a standard "request more" template.
Owen L: I'll include a "how to request more" paragraph linking to Support and noting the DSA requirement. Avoid commit hashes or raw traces in the public text.
AM Bot: Note: For contracted customers flagged SLA-high, route AM outreach template via @AMs channel after draft sign-off.
Priya S: For the affected list I'll add an "outreach owner" column so we can track who sends the tailored emails.
Maya R: Decision point: publish the short statuspage note now (transparency) and follow up with the sanitized summary after Legal redaction pass, or wait and post both together? Thoughts?
Legal Team: Publish a short statusline now (2 lines max). We'll aim to return the redaction checklist + template within 24 hours so the full summary can go live within 48 hours.
Owen L: Draft will be posted to #incidents-drafts in 30 mins for quick review. Please keep reviews light (tone + redaction) so we can hit the timeline.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-783 moved to postmortem by @maya at 2026-04-08T15:22:10Z.
Maya R: Action items recap: Owen -> statuspage + public summary draft by 11:00 UTC tomorrow. Priya -> affected account export + SLA flags by EOD today. Legal -> redaction checklist + request-template in 24h. I'll log these into the incident action tracker and run a Wednesday check-in. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
